# Aegean Sun

> Aegean Sun is a grower-direct Turkish exporter of dried fruit for trade buyers (importers, distributors, retail and private-label buyers, food service and industrial users). It sells four products: sun-dried figs from Aydın, fig salami, dried apricots from Malatya and dried mulberries from Anatolia. Figs are dried and packed at its own facility in Nazilli, Aydın; fig salami is pressed and cured at its plant in Athens. Shipments leave from İzmir. The site is in English and Turkish.

Key facts, as published on this site:

- Dried fig: Sarılop variety, Aydın. Grades Lerida, Protoben, Bağlama, Garland, Pulled, Layer, Makaroni, Diced 8×10 mm. Calibre No.1 (≤38 pcs/kg) to No.6 (≤110 pcs/kg). Moisture 22–24%. Shelf life 12 months at 4–18 °C. HS 0804.20.
- Fig salami: Aydın figs pressed and cured 14–21 days in Athens. Six varieties (smoked paprika, almond, pistachio, Moroccan spices, tikka masala, orange), 180 g logs, vegan, no added sugar. Shelf life 12 months. HS 2008.99.
- Dried apricot: Hacıhaliloğlu variety, Malatya. No.1 (≤60 pcs/kg) to No.6 (≤180 pcs/kg); sulphured to buyer specification or natural (0 ppm SO₂); organic lots; diced and puree formats. Shelf life 18 months. HS 0813.10.
- Dried mulberry: white mulberry dried by sun and wind with no processing, about 5 kg of fresh fruit per 1 kg dried; 12.5 kg bulk or any grammage. HS 0813.40.
- Terms: FCL, LCL or air freight from İzmir; EXW, FOB, CIF or DDP. Orders usually loaded within 10 working days.
- Graded sample sets are free for qualified trade buyers. Enquiries are answered within one working day.
- Contact: Muzaffer Türkekul, export sales, muzaffer.turkekul@aegeansunfruit.com, +90 507 863 40 45 (Mon–Fri 08:30–18:00, GMT+3).
